name: Detective Hank; A Prelude to Tea
source: Detective Hank finds himself at tea after work hours when his cookie gets stolen. Since Hank is a detective, he's going to find out who took his cookie and in the mean time, get himself another cookie from the kitchen.
translation: 汉克侦探下班后正在喝茶，这时他的饼干被偷了。由于汉克是一名侦探，他要找出谁拿走了他的饼干，同时从厨房给自己拿另一块饼干。
